svg.title: .SYSTEMX — SYSTEM MAP 2 / TASK + EVIDENCE
svg.desc: The task and evidence cycle connects the objective and canonical task ledger to Agent X timing, Agent Y selected CLI work, Agent Z review, and owner acceptance.
svg.text: Agent 0 coordinates; X, Y and Z return distinct evidence
Agent 0 plans, assigns, integrates and reviews
X: event/time Y: selected CLI task

root delta compares; it does not contact providers
